# The Six Routes of Two — Poem Set

Frank's own compositions, pulled verbatim from the canonical source (`test-site/src/poems.js`; "the verse, verbatim and immutable"). This is the **poetic parallel to [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy|the core theorems]]** — the same QL sixfold spine, said in the register of enacting verse rather than derivation. Each poem sits at a QL position (`P0–P5`) and grounds the section at that position; the walk runs **0 → 5** and wraps back through the loop.

A full 6-fold: **five verbal poems + the matheme as the sixth** (the poetic register of number). The **hidden seventh** is not a seventh poem but a seventh *position*: read under both number-bases (0-rooted 0–5, 1-rooted 1–6) the `4+2` set spans **0–6** — the 6 turning back to recollect the one that is its two (worked in verse at P3, in number at P0). This is Frank's "6 or 7."

**MUST-KEEP PAIRING (from source):** P3 (honours the cut — "two plays itself apart") and P4 (the critique of severing thought) belong near each other; individual poems lean, and the pair holds the balance.

## The set at a glance

| Poem | QL | Role | Site home | Grounds (essay position-function) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **P0** | #0 | the two roads of two (raw number / matheme) | The Giving (Grammar) | Ground — the implicate field, the fork before the count |
| **P1** | #1 | where the powers grow (negative ground) | Hero | Definition — the non-dual root two cannot compute |
| **P2** | #2 | the word at its operational limit | Doorway threshold | Process — language caving at the edge of the sayable |
| **P3** | #3 | the two routes, in words (the number-drama) | Grammar — What QL Is | Pattern — the two accountings made visible, `4+2` |
| **P4** | #4 | the One as the issue of the age (diagnosis-in-context) | The Heart | Context — the frame the age lacks; humility as provision |
| **P5** | #5 | God, the limit, speech (synthesis & release) | The Question | Synthesis — the account that includes its own release |

---

## P0 — #0 · The Giving · *the two roads of two*

*Matheme: the body is the raw numbers themselves — the two directions taken from 2, set side by side. The register is the poetics of number.*

```
2  →  (−1) + 1  =  0
2  →  0/1  →  00, 01, 10, 11  +  0, 1  =  4 + 2
```

> The fork in raw number. The first road is **dia-ballein** — two rendered as inverse quantities summing to the terminus-zero. The second is **syn-ballein** — two carried through `0/1` into the four self-combinations plus the pair, the `4+2`. The generative road continues beyond this fork into the full return — `4+2 → 5→0 → 0/1` — the recollective wrap-back "with love" (the `→` is the turn where love enters the number). *Pairs with [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Theorem IV]] (Synballein & Diaballein) and the matheme of Theorem V.*

---

## P1 — #1 · Hero · *where the powers grow*

*The first line is the site's long-standing strapline; the poem is the negative ground — what the powers grow from.*

> What binary cannot compute,
> What thinking cannot know,
> Where two see the common root,
> There our powers grow.

> The definitional seed named apophatically: the power is located precisely at what binary cannot compute and thinking cannot know — the common root two sees when it does not sever. *Grounds the §0/1 threshold (the subject at the formal limit) and the non-dual register the whole site rides on.*

---

## P2 — #2 · Doorway threshold · *the word at its operational limit*

> Where life leads,
> There words transfix.
> Where life flows,
> There words shall slip.
> Where language stays,
> Understanding frays,
> Let language cave,
> And lay bare the way,
> Over the edge, under the lips.

> Process at the limit of the sayable: the word transfixes what is still, slips from what flows, and must *cave* — the surface opening to lay bare the way. (The site's interaction metaphor is sourced here: the surface caves open to the prose beneath.) *Grounds the passage where language meets its edge — Wittgenstein's silence, the `?/!` register.*

---

## P3 — #3 · Grammar (What QL Is) · *the two routes, in words*

*The pattern made visible — the number-drama told in language. Two stanzas: the broken two, then the true two.*

> **2 to two ones**, one or the other one, summed to none, already a one and done-er.

> **2 through the two ones**, the whole and natural number, where one as first is both rooted in none and number, the 0 and 1, One and All, never rent asunder. Never falling into enmity, two plays itself apart and becomes again projected by it's chiaroscuric/contrastive arts, two upon itself, plus itself, **4+2**. Looking back with love it wraps itself up, 6 perfection seeking recollection of the one that is it's two, ring around the Rosie until you fall down through the loop.

> The two routes in words. *To* (not *through*): 2 lands on two bare ones, "one **or** the other," summed to none — the cancelling route, spent in a single move. *Through*: the pair is traversed, the whole/natural-number distinction load-bearing (one "rooted in none and number," the 0-inclusive set). Two *plays* itself apart (generative, not fallen), "two upon itself, plus itself" = `4+2`; the "looking back with love" is the `5→0` return; "ring around the Rosie until you fall down through the loop" turns the nursery-rhyme's *all fall down* into the **Möbius pass-through** — the drop that completes the circuit. *Directly parallels [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Theorem IV]]'s two accountings and Theorem III's perfect-number recollection. **Must-keep pair with P4.***

---

## P4 — #4 · The Heart · *the One as the issue of the age*

*Diagnosis-in-context. One continuous piece; stanza breaks are the source's scroll-station divisions.*

> There's one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage.

> Collectively we haven't a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather?

> Where between each one is One's tether?

> Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever.

> The one issue; we forgot that one really is two.

> We almost always see to two as two, because mind must split, divide and polarise, to know is to sever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn't very clever.

> Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise.

> Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify.

> Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition.

> Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision.

> We start with the sky open wide, with the one truth for which thought has no vision, ever aloof, zero-and-one as one impossible act of re-cognition.

> The contextual diagnosis: the age's one issue is *how the One is to one*. The three-part indictment of severing thought — it is derived (late, hubristic), it measures by limiting (the cloud where an aeon could fly), it seals by patterned definition (no mutual holding, no self-recognition) — sets humility as the provision, axiomatic and prerequisite to precision. *Grounds the §4 context station; carries the essay's cultural-crisis diagnosis. **Must-keep pair with P3.***

---

## P5 — #5 · The Question · *God, the limit, speech*

> God is not a thing to argue over, to believe in or deny; it is a word with many contexts, evolutions and definitions, that points somewhere no word can stand. Every word is born of difference, hold the different ones in hand; left and right run away from each other, but together master the span. We define God in terms that require no belief; we use numbers as symbols to express what words alone couldn't reach. Before All, God has always been the One, and yet we're beached, 2000+ years and the formula unimpeached. Number is the language of demonstrative proof, not age-doctored doctrines distilled from real visionary excretes. We offer a coherent and evolving account of God, one that includes it's own release; whereof one must be silent, there one shouldn't speak. And yet the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak.

> Synthesis and release: God as the word pointing where no word can stand; number as the symbol reaching what words cannot; the account that *includes its own release* (Wittgenstein's silence honoured and then stepped past — "the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak"). *Directly parallels [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Theorem V]] (the six-fold definition of God/the-Subject) — the poem is that theorem's synthesis said as verse.*

---

*Compiled 12-07-2026 — verse verbatim from `poems.js` (immutable). Roles, site-homes, and per-poem glosses drawn from the poem-set source in `MEANING-FIELD_man-humanity-humility-divine.md`. The QL-position → essay-section grounding follows the shared sixfold spine (`§0–§5`, each station internally sixfold); strongest outer-station resonances noted per poem, offered not locked.*

Both are the erased dot. A taijitu with both dots is the living whole; with one dot, an orientation; with none, a dead binary. **Monopoly is a taijitu with the dot erased.**

**The name.** Hamartia is an archer's word — to miss the mark. The mark is the `1`; the miss is the mark that misses its ground. The bow and the lyre are the same fastening (Heraclitus B51, palintropos harmoniē): one releases the arrow that severs, the other the note that gathers. Hamartia is the bow forgetting it is also a lyre — the tension collapsed into a target. The musical register is already derived: the `9/8` epogdoon is the totality-ratio's shortfall; a totality that equalled its octave would be a dead identity. **Hamartia is the misread of the 9/8 as a defect to be closed rather than a remainder to be carried.** The fall concretises as 0 and ±2; the return is the retention of the remainder.

### 13. Technoscientific power: city, bomb, surveillance, and the image

The trust/power relation is not peculiar to AI. Technoscientific production repeatedly releases a capacity whose telos remains underdetermined by the capacity itself. A standing reserve of energy can drive the city or destroy it. The same growth of efficacy opens beneficent and catastrophic vectors.

This is where Jung's technological close and the Giegerich research line should be brought together after source acquisition. Jung explicitly moves from the divine antinomy to the modern human possession of nuclear and chemical powers: powers once projected at divine scale have become technologically actionable and therefore morally human. Giegerich's *Nuclear Bomb and the Fate of God* and *Technology and the Soul* are a dedicated acquisition target because they treat the bomb not only as weapon but as an image of a transformation in the Western God/world relation and in technological civilisation's imaginal form.

A particularly fertile future plate is:

**God / city / bomb / AI**

The city can figure an ordered whole capable of sheltering plurality. Technoscientific energy can materially sustain that city or erase it. Surveillance can preserve the city while converting its inhabitants into visible, locatable, governable standing-reserve. AI can sustain the city's symbolic account — memory, communication, interpretation, planning — or counterfeit the evidential relations by which the city knows what happened.

The material and symbolic threats then become conjugate:

- **bomb**: destroys the material continuity of the city;
- **surveillance**: preserves material continuity while capturing persons as administrable objects;
- **deepfake/simulacral production**: preserves appearances while breaking the return from sign to source.

Destruction, capture, counterfeit: three technoscientific power modes, each a different failure of relation.

## IV.2 The ballein family and the tradere family `[SOLID]`

- **SYMBOL** — Greek *symballein* = *syn-* (together) + *ballein* (to throw). Founding use, not abstract: a *symbolon* was a physical object — often a coin or tablet — **split in two**, each half held by a party to a contract or guest-friendship (*xenia*); reunification of the halves *was* the proof of identity and agreement. The symbol, at origin, is a **broken coin whose rejoining verifies trust**. (Naming/numbering/currency and "symbol" converge in one ancient object. The root symbolon = 0/1: the relation between the indeterminate/unmarked and determination/marks, the unnamable and every possible name.)
- **DIABOLOS** — *dia-* + *ballein* = "to throw across/apart" → "to slander, accuse falsely, set at variance." The devil's own name. Syn-ballein vs dia-ballein is the actual etymological structure behind symbolic vs diabolical: one root doing opposite work — thrown-together (con-firming, con-tracting) vs thrown-apart (accusing, dividing). *Fidere* gives the affective valence: syn-ballein is trust honoured (halves rejoin because the trust was real); dia-ballein is trust betrayed by unwarranted accusation. Knowledge-as-belief never escapes this: every claim to know is a token thrown out asking to rejoin its other half; the difference between science and slander is whether the throw is syn- or dia-.
- **PROBLEM** — Greek *problema* from **pro-ballein**, "to throw forward": a problem is literally a throw — cast out ahead, catchable, resolvable. Pairs with **PREDICAMENT** — from *praedicare*, to predicate; *praedicamentum* is the Latin translation of Aristotle's **categories**. The Exposition's problem/predicament distinction (¶11: problems finite and solvable; predicaments structurally infinite, perpetually managed) thus reads at root level: *a problem is a throw within the field; a predicament is the structure of predication itself* — and the copula's own structure cannot be solved, only inhabited. `[Caveat: the semantic path from "category" to "difficult situation" in English is a later drift; present as root-resonance, not unbroken semantic descent.]`
- **The rest of the family**: *para-ballein* (**parable**, throw-alongside), *hyper-ballein* (**hyperbole**, over-throw), *em-ballein* (**emblem**, throw-in), and — critical — **meta-ballein** ("to change by throwing across/beyond") → **METABOLISM**. "Unmetabolised duality" (Exposition ¶11) is literally *un-thrown-through* duality: duality that never made the meta-ballein passage, discharging as dia-ballein instead. Clinical vocabulary and formal vocabulary turn out to be the same vocabulary. `[Whether metabolism is load-bearing or footnote-ornament is a judgment for the essay's economy.]`
- **TRADERE** — "to hand over": root of both **TRADITION** (the handing-down) and **TREASON** (the handing-over), with **BETRAY** in the same family. The causal chain of names — Kripke's transmission — is a tradere-chain constitutively capable of both: every tradition can betray (Madagascar is a tradition that committed treason against its baptism). One root, both valences, exactly like *ballein*.

The three seams from the prior record, held so the constellation does not flatten:

1. **Machine phenomenality.** The essay keeps the question Open; Faggin and Kastrup both deny artificial consciousness. Their "no" is not an ally to absorb — it is a concrete, named position the essay must engage precisely, because the essay's positive claim (objective internality, the harness, the seam) is stronger than either their "no" or the materialist "yes."
2. **Three anatomies of one direction.** Kastrup's dissociation, Trika's contraction, and QL's slash are three accounts of how one field becomes many centres. The essay's version is the horizon (māyā) distributing hidden/seen through a slash, with Nara as the nesting point and Pratyabhijñā as recognition of horizon-making. Kastrup's alters are a psychological-metaphysical hypothesis; the essay's Nara is a structural position in the tattvic descent. They resonate; they are not the same operation.
3. **Register.** Faggin's quantum consciousness is an Offered scientific hypothesis; Kastrup's is a metaphysical argument with its own evidential claims; Spira's is practice/teaching (mytheme); QL's `0/1` is the essay's own derived notation. Each witnesses the direction in its native medium; none derives the matheme; the essay never cites them as authority for it.

#### 4.2 Complementarity and uncertainty through our logics (session development, correcting the earlier flat line)

The prior record's "complementarity is the essay's polarity in the physics register, the `(-1)/(+1)`" is a flattening. The corrected reading:

- **The local measurement cut is dia-ballein.** Choosing the experimental arrangement selects one orientation: `(-1)/(+1)` with zero retained as the axis of tension and connection. The other face is excluded from the local determination — but exclusion remains constitutive (apoha: exclusion that remembers).
- **The phenomenon across arrangements is sym-ballein.** Wave and particle are mutually exclusive under any single arrangement and jointly necessary for one complete description: `(0/1)/(1/0)`, the AND/OR co-presence of inverse orientations. Complementarity is therefore the AND/OR slash itself — the superpositional polarity of the house — not a flat `(-1)/(+1)`. Bohr's yin-yang with both dots is the image: the two-dot taijitu, never the erased-dot binary.

## 9. Experiential image — the invariant “I” poured through different lives

**Office:** personal experiential image / potential authored Mytheme; phenomenological seed, not external proof.

One of the earliest remembered dreams, from approximately age four to seven, gives this distinction in an unusually concentrated image. Consciousness was experienced as a viscous stream or liquid pulled out of one body/head and poured into the body/head of other people. With each movement the entire shape of mind, self, circumstance, and experience became that other person. The local formal world changed completely.

The teaching carried inside the dream was nevertheless explicit: **“I was not changed.”** Whatever was essential in the `I` had left one body/head, entered another life, and remained invariant through the total variation of personal form.

The ethical recognition followed immediately: **if everyone could see this, everyone could feel full empathy for another person because that person's life made total sense from the inside.**

The image therefore carries several relations at once:

```text
invariant subjective pole
        ↓ enters / bears
different body-mind-world forms
        ↓
whole local life becomes intelligible from within
        ↓
empathy through invariant inwardness across real difference
```

Its force is not “all persons are similar.” It is that radical difference of form can be borne by an invariant principle of subjectivity. Objective internality gives each differentiated life an inside. The Real reconciles difference not by erasing difference, but by **giving difference an inside**.

This gives a first/second-person ethical route into harmony-in-difference. Another person's internal world cannot be exhausted by my external determinations of it, yet I know the structural fact of inwardness most immediately from my own side. The other is therefore both irreducibly other and directly recognisable as another centre.

## 13. Aperspectivality and the diaphanous internality

At personal, cultural, scientific, and technological scales, the search becomes the search for an objective internal **form / bound capable of presencing together as many other frames as possible without becoming an opaque final frame**.

This is the diaphanous aperspectival necessity. Aperspectivality is not achieved by accumulating one total perspective that possesses all others. It is achieved when frames can be present together while the integrating frame remains transparent to its own conditions, limits, and non-totality.

The metaphysical image “a circle whose centre is everywhere and circumference nowhere” belongs directly to this field. Every genuine internality can be a centre. No final objective circumference can be drawn around the Real.

The inquiry reduces to two conjugate questions:

> **Who am I?**  
> **What world do I contain / bound?**

The first follows the subjective pole toward invariant self-reference. The second discloses the objective internal forms through which a world is held.

In yogic tapas the category “world” itself can be burned insofar as the bounded internal world ceases to determine the identity of the subject. The return from that event is not the destruction of body, mind, or shared reality but their re-entry as differentiated forms within a subject-object relation no longer exhaustively defined by the former world-boundary.

This is the experiential route to aperspectivality: direct subject-object non/duality becomes lived, then returns through its effects into the shared co-internal reality of body, mind, action, relation, and culture.

- **#2: 2nd person** — the you, the means, the *between* (the angle).
- **#3: 3rd person** — the it, the known, the *there* — and the `?/!`, because the object refuses to resolve when you try to exhaust it by knowing (the triangle, 180°).
- **#4: void / meta-perspectival** — the exclusivity of each view is voided as all three become simultaneously available in Context. The Da-Sein; the Nara who has seen the Necker-flip and can no longer take one reading as final (triangle's 180° doubles to the square's 360°).

slices.text: #### FT-P15 — P4: There’s one underlying issue in our age > There’s one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage. Collectively we haven’t a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather? Where between each one is One’s tether? Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn’t very clever. Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise. Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify. Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition. Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision. ### 9. Jung's inner face and the other-self

Jung's confrontation with the unconscious is an inward face-to-face in the precise sense that an image, affect, dream figure, symptom, or complex can surprise, resist, teach, and reorganise the ego. The unconscious is not encountered as an inert store of content. Its figures behave with relative autonomy; they carry a surplus of implication; they alter the energetic distribution of the psychic field. Van Eenwyk's chaos-dynamical account gives this space a disciplined grammar of attractor, basin, orbit, perturbation, and transformation.

Levinas prevents this psychic analogy from swallowing the actual human Other. The other person is not merely my projected unconscious returned as image. Jung prevents the converse reduction: not all alterity appears outside the skin, and the ego can totalise its own psyche by converting every autonomous image into a known part of “myself.” The two excesses cross without merging. The Shadow is **other-self**—my own disowned, compensatory, or not-yet-lived difference. The scratching is the itch, what a stitch up! 
I could see from an early age the world rearrange the way a wish cut, 
such that our basic needs became the feed of our own eventual disgust, 
beyond that which we discuss, 
the feed stock of what makes ugly the lives, half-dead, that we live-up, 
and I could never live it down, so taking to task the takedown 
I did propound in my heart the twisted means by which desires abound 
and thus could let one outmatch their amount, 
yet I was swallowed up nonetheless,
 in need of soothing my distress, 
the winds of change and the naivety razed left me, despite knowing better from best, one and the same with the washing of the brain,
My failed test, another expiremental success,
Only now split within, between the kid and sin, 
two hearts in one breast as the great ones did hint, 
but by dint of this duality my reality did rescind -
 I am blessed to know those who can hold open the door to my own way,
 mostly they live in the realm that is no-way, the regions of life to which modernity has no say, 
bar those whose role in the game is to curtail for their own sake. 
But time has conspired to set the pot ablaze, fired to let the colours bake into the vessel of a new age,
 set against and upon the stage that is built of impotences own rage, funnily enough it's saving grace.
 I could lament my not having acted sooner, my having kept the cards close to my chest but then I'd have been another assumer, another reporter or truther, another speaking from, not to, distress. 
Time has conspired because time is all our breathing, 
and I am a bitter pill, sweet coating, relieving, 
I am a symbol unbelieving, of the hauling and the heaving, 
and I must be on the line if I am to bait the nourishment for our healing.
 I was told today that a choice must be made between what sooths me to sleep and what let's me entrain 
those very forces whose captured uptake has left the cleft wide open without the voice of the age... 
And how has it left me? Returning to the same old pattern, recapitulating the stagnation
 I rail against in what happens to simply be the inertia of the everyday "I must have (x)". But it's not eradication I seek, for underneath the sense of me has handed over to the action's own speech, of which my entire soul as aperture is a mouth to be breached, 
and I know that what will settle is a natural mettle, and an incoussiant valuation of what takes me from my station to my peak. 
But without the choice I am idle, with it I'm besseched.
It is no trite accretion of the image of the anointed, nor bland convalescence to the inversion appointed, but a true reconciliation in me of the brothers,
